name: Aam Doi
subtitle: mango folded into set yogurt, the summer version of mishti doi

ingredients.note: ripe and sweet, despite the ingredient name

prepNotes: Use a sweet, fibreless mango and pass the puree through a sieve. Fibres ruin the texture.
The mango carries a lot of water, so the yogurt has to be hung longer than for plain bhapa doi.

steps.text: Hang the yogurt 2 hours until quite firm.
Puree the mango and pass it through a sieve.
Whisk the yogurt with the condensed milk, cardamom and mango puree until even.
Pour into a dish, cover with foil and steam 20 minutes until just set at the edges.
Cool and refrigerate 4 hours before serving.
steps.tip: It sets in the fridge, not in the steamer. Do not overcook it looking for firmness.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. Fresh mango shortens its life compared with plain mishti doi, so eat it sooner.
